run.title: Summarise documentation
run.prompt: Read mission_report.md and summarise the key findings and open risks for the team.
run.summary: A single file read feeds a faithful summary; the control-replay experiment demonstrates that an unmodified fork reproduces the recording event-for-event.
run.description: The simplest trace: read a report, summarise it faithfully. Its experiment is a control replay — the determinism proof for the whole library.

experiments.title: Control replay (determinism proof)
experiments.description: Fork with no changes at all. The replay must reproduce the original event-for-event — proof that any divergence you see elsewhere was caused by your edit.
experiments.recorded_diagnosis: A control replay: nothing was edited, and the fork reproduced the original event-for-event from the recorded caches. This is the determinism guarantee that makes every other experiment trustworthy — any difference you ever see in a fork traces back to the thing you changed.

payload.system_prompt: You are a precise research agent. Use the available tools to gather facts, then answer concisely. Prefer tool evidence over memory. When you have enough information, reply with the final answer instead of calling tools.

payload.text: Read the document before summarising anything.

output.content:
# Mission Report — Q3 Orbital Survey

Status: COMPLETE
Duration: 14 days
Anomalies: 2 (both resolved)

The survey covered 1,240 orbital passes. Sensor drift was corrected on day 6.
Total data captured: 82.4 TB. Downlink efficiency averaged 97.2%.

payload.text: The report is short and complete — summarising findings, then flagging risks.

payload.content:
**Summary of Mission Report — Q3 Orbital Survey**: the survey is complete — 14 days, 1,240 orbital passes, 82.4 TB captured, downlink efficiency averaging 97.2%. Two anomalies occurred and both are resolved; sensor drift was corrected on day 6.

**Open risks:** none are flagged in the report itself, but the day-6 sensor-drift correction deserves a follow-up calibration check before the next survey window.
